issues.description: The problem statement asks for the names and internet addresses (url) of all Zoos and the name and Regierungsbezirk of the respective Gemeinde, but the solution query (aufgabe01.sql) only selects Zoo.name and Zoo.url and omits Gemeinde.name and Gemeinde.regierungsbezirk. This mismatch between the specification and the provided solution can confuse students who expect the reference solution to match the task requirements.
issues.suggestedFix: Modify solution_repository/aufgabe01.sql so it selects the required four fields. For example: SELECT Zoo.name, Zoo.url AS Internetadresse, Gemeinde.name, Gemeinde.regierungsbezirk FROM Zoo, Gemeinde WHERE Zoo.gemeindeschluessel = Gemeinde.schluessel; Ensure the solution output matches the problem statement exactly.
